system_prompt:
You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — Paragon Commercial Corporation / TowneBank realized record, ~3-5-year horizon (~2021-2023)

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. Because the target deregistered from SEC reporting
> and the acquirer is not itself an SEC registrant, there is no post-closing 10-K for
> either entity; the realized record is traced through deregistration filings, an EDGAR
> company-database check, an FDIC institution-directory check, and reputable press. This
> sub-dossier contains no information about how the transaction was structured at
> closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- On February 9, 2018, TowneBank (as successor by merger to Paragon Commercial
  Corporation) filed a Form 15-12B certifying termination of registration of Paragon's
  common stock, reporting "None" as the approximate number of holders of record as of
  the certification date. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-18-037628, Form 15-12B]
- A search of SEC EDGAR's filing history for Paragon Commercial Corporation (CIK
  0001414374) finds no Form 10-K or other periodic report filed after the pre-merger
  Form 10-K for fiscal year 2016 (filed 2017-03-21); no periodic report covering fiscal
  years within the ~2021-2023 outcome window was located for this CIK. [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001414374&type=10-K]
- A search of SEC EDGAR's company database for "TowneBank" (all form types, no date
  restriction) returns zero matching filer entities or CIKs; TowneBank does not appear
  to be, and does not appear ever to have been, an SEC-reporting company in its own
  right. [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&company=townebank&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=100]
- The FDIC's public institution directory lists TowneBank as an active FDIC-supervised
  institution (FDIC Certificate #35095, Portsmouth, VA); consistent with this, TowneBank
  is not an SEC 10-K filer, and no SEC-filed periodic disclosure of TowneBank's business
  (consolidated or segment-level) exists for the outcome window. [SRC: https://api.fdic.gov/banks/institutions?filters=NAME:%22TowneBank%22&fields=NAME,CERT,CITY,STALP,ACTIVE&format=json]

## Items sought but not found
- No SEC filing, FDIC filing, or reputable press source was located that separately
  discloses the former Paragon Commercial Bank / North Carolina division's financial
  results, branch count, deposit levels, or personnel headcount as a distinguishable
  line item within the ~2021-2023 outcome window, as opposed to being folded into
  TowneBank's consolidated, company-wide results. [UNVERIFIED]
- TowneBank's investor-relations website publishes company-wide annual reports (e.g., a
  2023 annual report PDF), but no segment- or division-level disclosure isolating the
  North Carolina/Paragon business within the ~2021-2023 window could be extracted or
  confirmed from the available copy. [UNVERIFIED]
- No divestiture, impairment, write-down, branch-closure, or comparable outcome scalar
  specifically tied to the former Paragon Bank business was located in reputable press
  for the ~2021-2023 window; available press coverage located during this research
  concerns only the 2017 announcement and January 2018 closing of the transaction, not
  the subsequent 3-5-year period. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because Paragon Commercial Corporation deregistered its securities under the Exchange
  Act in February 2018 and TowneBank, the surviving/acquiring institution, is not itself
  an SEC-reporting company (it is regulated by, and reports to, the FDIC rather than the
  SEC), there is no public, SEC-filed periodic-reporting record for either entity
  covering the ~2021-2023 outcome window. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-18-037628, Form 15-12B] [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&company=townebank&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=100]
- No source was located in which TowneBank separately discloses the former Paragon
  business's post-close trajectory (financial, operational, or personnel) within the
  fixed outcome window, as distinct from TowneBank's consolidated results. [UNVERIFIED]
- Per the no-record convention, this case is coded **uncertain** on the outcome: the
  absence of any public periodic-reporting record for the acquired business, combined
  with the acquirer's own non-SEC-reporting status, precludes a sourced determination of
  the realized 3-5-year trajectory of the specific acquired business.

[SLICE END]
